column2: 1. Duplicate all five tabs for each new client or brand experience. Summary and Checklist read each other by name, so keep them together.
2. Fill in Appendix A first. It is the scope agreement, and it decides which rows apply. Appendix B is completed at the same stage but tests nothing.
3. Work through the Checklist against the live build. Use the Status dropdown in column I.
4. Mark a row N/A where the Applies when condition is not met on Appendix A.
5. Log evidence in column J as video and timestamp, for example V1 04:12. Exporting that column gives you the timestamp index Apple asks for alongside the recordings.
6. Summary rolls up automatically. Formulas recalculate on open.
7. Section 0 is a final pre-submission gate, not a re-test. It holds only the items not duplicated elsewhere. See the mapping below.

Appendix A and Appendix B reproduce Apple's own brand facing forms, Messages for Business Use Cases and Messages for Business Readiness Review. Apple recommends that brands complete both at the start of the engagement. They are included here so the answers sit alongside the tests they govern. Appendix A drives which rows apply. Appendix B is commercial and operational qualification and tests nothing against the build.
